Charms, chains, and hundreds of ways to make it YOURS 💫🔗 This is craft night with a purpose — pick your carabiner, load it up with charms, beads, acrylics, whatever screams your vibe, and bedazzle till your heart's content. No wrong answers here, just good company and glitter everywhere. Every ticket goes straight into funding upcoming Sapphic events at Azucar, so you're not just building a keychain — you're building what's next. Bring your friends, bring your creativity, leave with a one-of-a-kind piece nobody else has. Craft. Bedazzle. Build community. That's the whole night in three words 🌈✨
